reviewItem.question: Does "Logs RBAC enforcement as a first-class RBAC citizen: 2.4 introduced `logs` as a new RBAC resource" mean a change to config-key:argo-cd|path=server.rbac.log.enforce.enable|component=argocd-cm (removed)?

proposed.statement: Starting in 3.0 the argocd-cm flag server.rbac.log.enforce.enable is removed and logs RBAC is always enforced, so the logs tab on pod view is hidden unless users have explicit `logs, get` permission.
